script_text:
Uranus, your ruling planet, sparks an Air‑charged week of breakthroughs and love turbulence!
Early this week, Mercury trines Uranus in the 1st House Monday, boosting ideas and talk, making Monday your peak. Wednesday drags as the Sun squares Saturn in the 10th House, stalling career moves and weighing you down. Mid‑week Thursday, Venus sextiles Neptune in the 7th House, easing doubts and opening romance. Late week brightens: Jupiter slips into the 5th House Saturday, fueling creative love and artistic luck, while a tense Mercury‑opposition‑Pluto on Sunday creates office power plays to navigate. Thursday shines as your lucky day Venus gently sextiles Neptune in the 7th House, magnifying romance. Wednesday stays tough as the Sun squares Saturn in the 10th House, throttling ambition. Tip: lock in that project proposal before Thursday’s Venus boost fades and voice your ideas at work. Follow for daily updates.
